body.p: After . Done when 1.23b's list of missing functions holds only 's non-goals, fn:serialize (3.4) and fn:load-xquery-module (3.11).

Done 2026-10-17 (): every function of the list, plus fn:doc's options, strip-space="all" and collations in min/max, highest/lowest, sort-by and array:sort; new part type and src/function_library_options.c. The missing list (every fn/map/array/math name of the XP40 sets, looked up at arities 0 to 6) now holds 's non-goals (html-doc, parse-html, invisible-xml, xsd-validator), load-xquery-module (3.11), transform, and 2.15's CSV functions.

2.6b Done 2026-10-17 (, orchestrator-assigned): the 16 built-in record types of F&O 4.0, appendix C, declared per type registry by the function library (src/function_library_records.c); parts-of-dateTime, divide-decimals, random-number-generator, regex and matching-segments return annotated records; maps coerce to nominative record types; ?take takes xs:nonNegativeInteger; INF idiv 0 is FOAR0001. fn-parts-of-dateTime 20/20, fn-divide-decimals 21/21, fn-random-number-generator 54/54 run, fn-regex 29/30, fn-matching-segments 38/38 run, op-numeric-integer-divide 132/132 run (no wrong errors).
